Revolution brings you 4 brand-new Multiplayer Maps: Downhill, Hydro, Mirage and Grind. You will also receive a bonus weapon - the Peacekeeper hybrid SMG-Assault Rifle. 
 
Also included is the brand new Zombies Co-Op Map, Die Rise, and the new Zombies game mode, Turned, which puts players into the role of the zombie. Visit the Store to buy the Revolution DLC Pack now.

Uprising includes four Multiplayer Maps: Magma, Encore, Vertigo, and Studio: a re-imagined adaptation of the fan-favorite Black Ops multiplayer map Firing Range. 
 
Also included is Mob of the Dead, the new Zombies Map where four Prohibition-era gangsters are forced to fend off hordes of the undead while imprisoned on San Francisco's notorious Alcatraz Island.

Vengeance includes four new Multiplayer Maps: Cove, Detour, Rush, and Uplink: a reimagined adaptation of the fan-favorite Black Ops multiplayer map Summit.

And in Treyarch's latest epic Zombies chapter, Buried, players will be challenged to face their deepest fears, trapped inside a long-forgotten subterranean Old West mining town.

Apocalypse deploys with two all-new Multiplayer Maps and the return of two completely re-imagined Multiplayer classics.

Origins, Treyarch's deepest and most imaginative Zombies experience yet, transports players to a Dieselpunk-themed First World War, returning the four original characters!
